risks.title: Opposition by First Nations to operations
risks.score_rationale: Risk explicitly cited at the outset of Item 1A with direct language ("opposition by First Nations groups"). Neutral language but sensitive context for oil and gas operations in Alberta. Trend stable but structural for Canadian energy sector. High weight: SAGD Hangingstone operations in sensitive Indigenous territory.

risks.title: Recruitment and retention of skilled personnel
risks.score_rationale: Risk explicitly stated ("inability to recruit and retain a skilled workforce and key personnel"). Moderate language but acknowledges structural challenge. Trend stable in oil and gas sector post-energy transition. Moderate weight: increased competition for talent in context of sector's relative decline.

risks.title: Physical impacts of climate change on production
risks.score_rationale: Specific risk cited ("potential physical effects of climate change on the Company's production and costs"). Direct language acknowledging operational vulnerability. Trend increasing: growing concern for thermal assets in vulnerable zones. Moderate to high weight: water and energy-intensive SAGD facilities vulnerable to climate extremes.

risks.title: Direct and indirect costs of environmental regulations
risks.score_rationale: Risk explicitly stated ("direct and indirect costs of various GHG and other environmental regulations"). Language acknowledges exposure to existing and proposed regulations. Trend increasing: Canada strengthens GHG standards and oil regulations. High weight: thermal oil sector is priority target of federal and provincial climate policies.

risks.title: Cybersecurity breaches and data loss
risks.score_rationale: Risk explicitly cited ("breaches of the Company's cyber-security and loss of, or unauthorized access to, data"). Direct language acknowledging threat. Trend increasing: rising attacks on energy sector. Moderate weight: sensitive operational data (reserves, production) and critical SCADA systems for SAGD.

risks.title: Compliance with anticorruption and economic sanctions laws
risks.score_rationale: Risk explicitly stated ("failure to comply with anticorruption, economic sanctions, and anti-money laundering laws"). Direct language. Trend increasing: geopolitical sanctions (Russia, Iran) affecting energy sector. Moderate weight: Greenfire operates internationally (JACOS acquisition, Trafigura partnership), exposed to complex compliance risks.

risks.title: Dependence on SAGD technology and operational risks
risks.score_rationale: Major implicit risk: 100% of assets are thermal SAGD facilities (Hangingstone Demo and Expansion). Indirect language but operational criticality evident. Trend stable but structural. Very high weight: extreme technology concentration, no geographic or production type diversification.

risks.title: Reserves and preliminary estimate risks
risks.score_rationale: Explicit risk in forward-looking statements ("reserves are deemed to be forward-looking statements"). Language acknowledges uncertainty ("inherently uncertain", "preliminary in nature"). Trend stable but structural. Moderate to high weight: Greenfire valuation ($950M enterprise value) rests on McDaniel reserve estimates.

ai_positioning.summary: There is no mention of artificial intelligence, machine learning, or related technologies in filed documents. The Company operates in the oil and gas resources sector with no indication of AI adoption or integration.
